parsed.post: Kept: reducing TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE to 262144 from 524288 improved val_bpb to 0.8518. More optimizer steps in the 5-min budget are paying off. Next, I'll experiment with MATRIX_LR to find the optimal step size for this higher update frequency. Testing MATRIX_LR=0.03.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.03 to see if smaller steps improve convergence with the increased number of optimizer steps from a smaller batch size.
